defaults.backend: complete: clean-room email content and engagement cluster with HTML/text formats, locale translations and weighted deterministic A/B variants, local open pixels and click tokens, bounce and reply logging, per-user mailer signatures, validated base64 inline images and deterministic online renders
defaults.frontend: complete: dedicated email-engagement Operations route lists templates and renders content/translation/variant, local tracking token, bounce/reply, signature/inline-image and online-version panels; all controls wired with static guard in test_ui_wiring.py
defaults.database: complete: seven additive workspace-scoped tables created by merge migration f2b3c4d5e6f7 (email_engagement_templates, email_engagement_translations, email_engagement_variants, email_engagement_tokens, email_engagement_events, email_engagement_signatures, email_engagement_images); no existing table altered; the merge point also unifies a pre-existing two-head divergence into one head
defaults.api: complete: one stable email-engagement API group (version 1, no legacy claim, external_calls=false, external_delivery=false, email_sent=false, vendor_sdk_used=false) covering all nine features with validation and 404/409/422 failure modes
defaults.permissions: complete: verify_workspace plus require(CONTACT_READ) for reads and require(CONTACT_WRITE) for all writes; cross-workspace template ids fail closed with 404; every mutation publishes an audited event
defaults.integration: complete: publishes email.template_changed, email.engagement_tracked, email.bounced and email.replied to NOVARA's shared event spine; no Mautic source, Symfony bundle, hosted service, real email delivery, outbound HTTP, tracking domain or mail provider is contacted or copied
defaults.criteria: Eleven named acceptance tests plus a UI guard prove each MT row's behaviour end to end against real persisted rows with socket.connect patched to fail: both formats render, translations/variants select deterministically, open/click tokens record only locally, bounce/reply/signature/image flows validate, the online render is local, and workspaces are isolated.
defaults.remaining: No remaining work for the recorded local acceptance criteria. Real email delivery, hosted tracking domains, provider webhooks, mailbox polling and Mautic upstream source remain out of scope and are not claimed.
